import pytest
from your_module import camel_to_snake  # replace with actual module name


class TestCamelToSnakeHappyPath:
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "input_str, expected",
        [
            ("camelCase", "camel_case"),
            ("CamelCase", "camel_case"),          # PascalCase
            ("camelCamelCase", "camel_camel_case"),
            ("camelCaseXML", "camel_case_xml"),   # acronym at end
            ("camelCase123", "camel_case123"),    # numbers after letters
            ("camelCase123Case", "camel_case123_case"),  # numbers between words
            ("aB", "a_b"),
            ("AB", "ab"),                         # all caps short
            ("already_snake", "already_snake"),   # already snake_case
            ("camel_Case", "camel_case"),         # mixed with underscore
            ("camel__Case", "camel__case"),       # double underscore
            ("camel Case", "camel case"),         # space (treated as non-letter)
        ],
    )
    def test_happy_path(self, input_str, expected):
        assert camel_to_snake(input_str) == expected


class TestCamelToSnakeEdgeCases:
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "input_str, expected",
        [
            ("", ""),                     # empty string
            ("c", "c"),                   # single lowercase
            ("C", "c"),                   # single uppercase
            ("123", "123"),               # only digits
            ("camel123case", "camel123case"),  # no uppercase
            ("ALLCAPS", "allcaps"),       # all uppercase
            ("HTTPServer", "httpserver"), # acronym at start (no lowercase before)
            ("XMLParser", "xmlparser"),   # acronym at start
            ("camelCaseXMLParser", "camel_case_xml_parser"),  # multiple acronyms
            ("camelCaseXML", "camel_case_xml"),
            ("camelCaseXMLParser", "camel_case_xml_parser"),
            ("camelCase123", "camel_case123"),
            ("camel123Case", "camel123case"),  # digit before uppercase -> no split
        ],
    )
    def test_edge_cases(self, input_str, expected):
        assert camel_to_snake(input_str) == expected


class TestCamelToSnakeErrorCases:
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "invalid_input",
        [
            None,
            123,
            3.14,
            [],
            {},
            set(),
        ],
    )
    def test_type_error(self, invalid_input):
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            camel_to_snake(invalid_input)
